# Calcrafty

> Calcrafty builds free online calculators for money, health, math and everyday questions, with live data, plain-English answers and the math shown step by step.

Every calculator shows its formula, substitutes the user’s numbers step by step, and cites its sources. Live defaults (mortgage rates, inflation, Treasury yields) come from FRED and show an "as of" date. Content is reviewed by a person before it is indexed.

## Calculators

- [401(k) Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/401k-calculator/): Project your 401(k) balance at retirement with your contributions, employer match, raises and 2026 IRS limits, and see how much match you may be leaving behind.
- [Age Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/age-calculator/): Find your exact age in years, months and days from your date of birth, plus total weeks and days lived, the weekday you were born and your next birthday.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/amortization-calculator/): Free amortization calculator: a payment-by-payment schedule with dates, the payoff date, and what monthly, yearly or lump-sum extra payments save in interest.
- [APR Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/apr-calculator/): Find the real APR of a loan with origination fees and points included, using the same method lenders must use. Compare APR with the interest rate in seconds.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/auto-loan-calculator/): Calculate your car payment with down payment, trade-in, sales tax and fees. See the amount financed, total interest and how loan length changes the total cost.
- [BMI Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/health/bmi-calculator/): Calculate your adult BMI in pounds and feet or kilograms and centimeters. See your CDC weight category, the healthy weight range for your height and its limits.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/health/body-fat-calculator/): Estimate body fat percentage with the US Navy tape-measure method and the BMI method. See your fat and lean mass and where you fall on the ACE body fat chart.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/health/calorie-calculator/): Estimate your daily calorie needs (TDEE) with the Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict or Katch-McArdle formula, and the calories to lose, keep or gain weight.
- [Car Affordability Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/car-affordability-calculator/): Find the most you should spend on a car from your income, down payment, trade-in and today’s auto loan rate, using the 20/4/10 rule with insurance and fuel.
- [Car CO2 Emissions Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/ecology/car-co2-calculator/): Calculate your car’s yearly CO2 emissions from miles driven and mpg, using the EPA figure of 8,887 grams per gallon of gas, and compare with a typical car.
- [CD Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/cd-calculator/): Calculate how much a CD earns by maturity from its APY and term, see your return after tax and inflation, and see what an early withdrawal penalty costs you.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/compound-interest-calculator/): Free compound interest calculator: see how savings grow with daily, monthly or annual compounding and monthly deposits, with APY, a chart and a yearly table.
- [Concrete Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/concrete-calculator/): Calculate concrete for a slab, footing or round column in cubic yards, cubic feet and cubic meters, plus how many 40, 60 or 80 lb bags to buy, waste included.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/credit-card-payoff-calculator/): See how long it takes to pay off a credit card, the total interest, the payment to be debt-free by a date, and how much paying only the minimum would cost you.
- [Days Between Dates Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/days-between-dates-calculator/): Count the days between two dates, in days, weeks and months, plus business days with weekends and US federal holidays excluded. Include or exclude the end date.
- [Debt Payoff Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/debt-payoff-calculator/): Compare the debt snowball and avalanche methods side by side. Enter your debts and extra payment to see your debt-free date, total interest and payoff order.
- [Debt-to-Income Ratio Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/debt-to-income-ratio-calculator/): Calculate your front-end and back-end debt-to-income ratio and see if it meets conventional, FHA, VA or USDA limits, plus the largest housing payment you fit.
- [Discount Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/math/discount-calculator/): Work out the sale price and your savings for any percent or dollar discount, stack an extra coupon on top and add sales tax, with a table from 10% to 75% off.
- [Electricity Cost Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/physics/electricity-cost-calculator/): Work out what an appliance costs to run per hour, day, month and year from its watts (or amps and volts), hours of use and your price per kWh, with the math.
- [Emergency Fund Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/emergency-fund-calculator/): Work out your emergency fund target from your essential monthly expenses, see how many months your savings cover now, and how long it takes to reach the goal.
- [Final Grade Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/final-grade-calculator/): Find the score you need on your final exam to reach a target grade, from your current grade and the final’s weight, plus the score needed for each letter.
- [Flooring Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/flooring-calculator/): Calculate how much flooring you need: room square footage plus a waste allowance, the boxes to buy and the cost, for laminate, vinyl, hardwood or tile.
- [Fraction Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/math/fraction-calculator/): Add, subtract, multiply and divide fractions and mixed numbers. Get the simplified answer, mixed number and decimal, with every step from LCD to GCD shown.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/other/fuel-cost-calculator/): Work out the gas cost of any road trip or commute from distance, mpg and this week’s U.S. average gas price, one way or round trip, split between passengers.
- [GPA Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/gpa-calculator/): Calculate weighted and unweighted GPA on a 4.0 scale from letter grades and credit hours, with Honors and AP bonuses and your cumulative GPA across semesters.
- [Gravel Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/gravel-calculator/): Calculate how much gravel or crushed stone you need in cubic yards and tons for a driveway, patio or path, with extra for compaction and the number of bags.
- [HELOC Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/heloc-calculator/): Estimate your home equity line of credit limit, the interest-only payment while you draw and the higher payment when repayment begins, plus total interest.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/health/ideal-weight-calculator/): Find your ideal body weight for your height and sex with the Robinson, Miller, Devine and Hamwi formulas, compared side by side with the healthy BMI range.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/inflation-calculator/): See what money from any year since 1913 is worth today using official CPI data, the total and average inflation between two years, and future prices.
- [Investment Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/investment-calculator/): Free investment calculator: project growth from a starting amount and monthly contributions that rise each year, and see the result in today’s dollars.
- [Length Converter](https://calcrafty.com/conversion/length-converter/): Convert lengths between mm, cm, meters, km, inches, feet, yards, miles and nautical miles with exact factors, and see any length in feet and inches.
- [Loan Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/loan-calculator/): Free loan calculator: the monthly payment and total interest on a personal or other fixed-rate loan, with the amortization schedule and extra-payment savings.
- [Macro Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/health/macro-calculator/): Calculate your daily macros: grams of protein, carbs and fat for your calorie goal, with balanced, high-protein, low-carb, keto or custom splits.
- [Margin Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/margin-calculator/): Find gross profit margin and markup from cost and price, or the price for a target margin. Shows profit per unit and in total, and converts margin to markup.
- [Mean, Median and Mode Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/statistics/mean-median-mode-calculator/): Find the mean, median, mode and range of a list of numbers instantly. Paste values from a spreadsheet and see the sorted list, the sum and each step worked out.
- [Molarity Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/chemistry/molarity-calculator/): Calculate molarity in mol/L from the mass of solute and volume of solution, or the grams to weigh out, with molar masses of common compounds built in.
- [Mortgage Affordability Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/mortgage-affordability-calculator/): See how much house you can afford from your income, debts and down payment. Uses lender 28/36 debt-to-income rules, today’s mortgage rate, taxes and insurance.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/mortgage-calculator/): Calculate your monthly mortgage payment with property tax, insurance, PMI and HOA. Uses this week’s average rate, shows amortization and extra-payment savings.
- [Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/mortgage-payoff-calculator/): Free mortgage payoff calculator: enter your current balance, rate and payment to see your payoff date and what extra payments or a lump sum save in interest.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/net-worth-calculator/): Calculate your net worth from your assets and debts, see your home equity and liquid net worth, and compare it with the Federal Reserve median for your age.
- [Ohm’s Law Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/physics/ohms-law-calculator/): Find voltage, current, resistance or power from any two known values with Ohm’s law (V = I × R) and the power formula P = V × I, each step shown.
- [Overtime Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/overtime-calculator/): Calculate overtime pay at time and a half for hours over 40 a week, or under California’s daily overtime and double-time rules, with weekly and yearly totals.
- [Paint Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/paint-calculator/): Work out how much paint a room needs: wall area minus doors and windows, times the coats, divided by coverage, with exactly how many gallons and quarts to buy.
- [Pay Raise Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/pay-raise-calculator/): Work out your new pay from a percentage or dollar raise, see the extra per paycheck, month and year, and check whether the raise beats this year’s inflation.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/paycheck-calculator/): Free 2026 paycheck calculator: see take-home pay after federal tax, Social Security, Medicare, state tax and 401(k). Salary or hourly, any pay frequency.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/math/percentage-calculator/): Free percentage calculator: find X% of a number, what percent one number is of another, percent increase or decrease, and sale prices, with the working shown.
- [Punnett Square Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/biology/punnett-square-calculator/): Make a Punnett square for monohybrid, dihybrid or trihybrid crosses, with every offspring genotype and the genotype and phenotype ratios shown.
- [Pythagorean Theorem Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/math/pythagorean-theorem-calculator/): Solve a² + b² = c² for the hypotenuse or a missing leg of a right triangle, with the exact square-root answer, both angles, area and perimeter, step by step.
- [Recipe Scaler](https://calcrafty.com/food/recipe-scaler/): Scale a recipe up or down to any number of servings. Paste the ingredients and get each amount resized and rounded to kitchen fractions like 1/3 cup.
- [Refinance Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/refinance-calculator/): See your new mortgage payment, when a refinance breaks even and whether it saves money over the life of the loan, including the cost of restarting the term.
- [Rent vs Buy Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/rent-vs-buy-calculator/): Should you rent or buy? Compare your net worth after renting vs buying, with every cost of owning, home price growth, invested savings and a break-even year.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/retirement-calculator/): Free retirement calculator: project your savings, see the nest egg you need after Social Security and inflation, how long it lasts and what to save each month.
- [Roofing Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/roofing-calculator/): Calculate your roof area from the house footprint, overhang and pitch, then convert it to roofing squares and bundles of shingles, with a waste allowance.
- [Running Pace Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/sports/running-pace-calculator/): Calculate running pace per mile or km, finish time or distance for a 5K, 10K, half or full marathon. Includes mile or km splits and race predictions by Riegel.
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/salary-to-hourly-calculator/): Convert salary to hourly pay or hourly pay to an annual salary in both directions, with weekly, biweekly, monthly and yearly amounts and your real hourly rate.
- [Savings Goal Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/savings-goal-calculator/): Free savings goal calculator: the monthly amount to reach a goal by a deadline, or how long it takes at your budget, with interest included and a yearly plan.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/math/scientific-calculator/): Free online scientific calculator: trig in degrees or radians, logs, powers, roots, factorials and π. Type on your keyboard or tap the keypad; answers are live.
- [Simple Interest Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/simple-interest-calculator/): Calculate simple interest with I = Prt, or solve for the principal, rate or time. Enter time in years, months or days, on an actual/365 or actual/360 basis.
- [Square Footage Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/construction/square-footage-calculator/): Free square footage calculator: area in square feet for rectangles, L-shaped rooms, circles and triangles, converted to square yards, square meters and acres.
- [Standard Deviation Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/statistics/standard-deviation-calculator/): Find the sample and population standard deviation, variance, mean and standard error of a data set, with a deviations table and every step of the working shown.
- [Student Loan Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/finance/student-loan-calculator/): Free student loan calculator: payments and total interest under the Standard, Graduated, Extended and 2026 Tiered Standard plans, plus extra-payment savings.
- [Temperature Converter](https://calcrafty.com/conversion/temperature-converter/): Convert temperatures between Fahrenheit, Celsius, kelvin and Rankine with exact formulas, see every scale at once, and convert a temperature change correctly.
- [Time Card Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/time-card-calculator/): Add up hours worked from clock-in and clock-out times, minus unpaid breaks, including overnight shifts. See decimal hours, overtime after 40 and weekly pay.
- [Tip Calculator](https://calcrafty.com/other/tip-calculator/): Calculate the tip and total on any bill, split it evenly between friends and round each share up to the dollar, with a table of 15%, 18% and 20% tips.
- [Weight Converter](https://calcrafty.com/conversion/weight-converter/): Convert weights between kilograms, pounds, ounces, grams, stone, metric, short and long tons and troy ounces, with exact factors and pounds-and-ounces results.

## Guides

- [What Is a Good Debt-to-Income Ratio?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/good-debt-to-income-ratio/): A good debt-to-income ratio is 35% or less. See the DTI limits for conventional, FHA, VA and USDA mortgages, what counts as debt and how to lower your ratio.
- [What Is a Good Net Worth by Age?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/good-net-worth-by-age/): Median net worth by age from the Federal Reserve: $39,000 under 35 to $410,000 at 65 to 74. See income-based benchmarks and how to grow your own net worth.
- [How Is APR Calculated?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-apr-is-calculated/): How APR is calculated under Regulation Z: the amount financed, the payment and the rate that ties them together, with car, personal loan and mortgage examples.
- [How Does Mortgage Amortization Work?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-does-mortgage-amortization-work/): How mortgage amortization works: why early payments are mostly interest, when principal takes over, and what extra payments save, shown on a $300,000 loan.
- [How Many Calories Should I Eat?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-many-calories-should-i-eat/): How many calories you need a day by age, sex, size and activity, how to set a safe deficit to lose weight, and why your number may differ from the average.
- [How Much CO2 Does a Car Produce?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-co2-does-a-car-produce/): How much CO2 a car produces per gallon, mile and year, from EPA figures: 8,887 grams per gallon of gasoline and about 4.6 metric tons a year for a typical car.
- [How Much Do I Need to Retire?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-do-i-need-to-retire/): Work out how much you need to retire: your income target, what Social Security covers, the 25x and 4% rules, and examples for $50,000 to $100,000 of income.
- [How Much Electricity Do Appliances Use?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-electricity-do-appliances-use/): How much electricity appliances use: a wattage chart for nearly 30 devices, yearly kWh and cost examples, standby power, and how to measure your own usage.
- [How Much House Can I Afford?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-house-can-i-afford/): How much house you can afford on your salary, with examples from $60,000 to $150,000 of income, the 28/36 rule lenders use and what changes your budget most.
- [How Much Should I Contribute to My 401(k)?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-to-contribute-to-401k/): How much to put in your 401(k): get the full match first, aim for 15% of pay including the match, and see what 2%, 6%, 10% and 15% contributions grow to.
- [How Much to Tip](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-much-to-tip/): How much to tip in the U.S.: typical ranges for restaurants, bartenders, delivery, rideshares, salons, hotels and movers, plus quick ways to work out the tip.
- [How to Calculate a Discount](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-calculate-a-discount/): How to calculate a discount step by step: sale price from percent off, the percent off between two prices, the original price, stacked coupons and shortcuts.
- [How to Calculate Gas Mileage](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-calculate-gas-mileage/): How to calculate gas mileage: the fill-up method, averaging mpg over several tanks, converting to L/100 km, comparing with EPA ratings and what lowers your mpg.
- [How to Calculate Molarity](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-calculate-molarity/): Learn how to calculate molarity step by step: moles from grams, liters of solution, preparing and diluting solutions with M1V1 = M2V2, and practice problems.
- [How to Calculate a Percentage](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-calculate-percentage/): Learn how to calculate a percentage of a number, what percent one number is of another, and percent change, with simple formulas, shortcuts and worked examples.
- [How to Calculate Square Footage](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-calculate-square-footage/): How to calculate square footage step by step: measuring rooms, splitting L-shapes and odd shapes, circles, bays, walls and whole homes, with worked examples.
- [How to Do a Punnett Square](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-do-a-punnett-square/): Learn how to do a Punnett square step by step: find the gametes, fill in the grid and read genotype and phenotype ratios, with dihybrid examples and answers.
- [How to Pay Off Debt Faster](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-pay-off-debt/): A step-by-step plan to pay off debt faster: list your debts, pick the snowball or avalanche method, find extra money and avoid new debt, with worked examples.
- [How to Pay Off Your Mortgage Early](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-pay-off-mortgage-early/): Seven ways to pay off a mortgage early, compared on a $300,000 loan: how much time and interest each saves, what to check first, and when it isn't worth it.
- [How to Read a Pay Stub](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-read-a-pay-stub/): Learn how to read a pay stub: gross pay, federal withholding, Social Security, Medicare, pre-tax deductions and year-to-date totals, with a worked example.
- [How to Scale a Recipe](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-scale-a-recipe/): How to scale a recipe: find the scale factor, turn awkward amounts into spoons, pick the right pan size and adjust baking time when halving or doubling.
- [How to Use the Pythagorean Theorem](https://calcrafty.com/guides/how-to-use-the-pythagorean-theorem/): How to use the Pythagorean theorem step by step: label the sides, set up a² + b² = c², solve for any side, with word problems, 3D diagonals and triple patterns.
- [Is Refinancing Worth It?](https://calcrafty.com/guides/is-refinancing-worth-it/): Is a 1% lower mortgage rate worth refinancing? See monthly savings by loan size, how long closing costs take to repay, and why a new 30-year term can cost more.
- [Margin vs Markup](https://calcrafty.com/guides/margin-vs-markup/): Margin vs markup explained: the formulas, how to convert one to the other, conversion charts, and worked examples from retail, restaurants and contracting.
- [Metric Conversion Chart](https://calcrafty.com/guides/metric-conversion-chart/): A metric conversion chart for length, weight, volume, area, speed and temperature, with exact factors, quick mental shortcuts and worked everyday examples.
- [How Long to Pay Off a Credit Card at Minimum Payments](https://calcrafty.com/guides/minimum-payment-payoff-time/): How long it takes to pay off a credit card making only minimum payments, with tables by balance and APR, why it takes so long and the fastest ways to get out.
- [Ohm's Law Explained](https://calcrafty.com/guides/ohms-law-explained/): Ohm's law explained simply: what voltage, current and resistance are, how V = I × R and P = V × I work, and worked examples from LEDs to household circuits.
- [Roth vs Traditional 401(k)](https://calcrafty.com/guides/roth-vs-traditional-401k/): Roth vs traditional 401(k): see how each is taxed, when your tax rate now and in retirement makes one better, and why many people split contributions.
- [Student Loan Repayment Plans](https://calcrafty.com/guides/student-loan-repayment-plans/): Federal student loan repayment plans after the July 2026 changes: Standard, Tiered Standard, RAP, IBR, Graduated and Extended, with examples and how to choose.

- [Health Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/health/): Free health calculators for BMI, daily calories, body fat, macros and ideal weight. Imperial or metric units, cited clinical formulas and clear answers.
- [Construction Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/construction/): Free construction calculators for concrete, flooring, paint, roofing, gravel and square footage: quantities with waste allowances and the math shown.
- [Math Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/math/): Free math calculators for percentages, discounts, fractions, the Pythagorean theorem and scientific functions, with the working shown step by step.
- [Statistics Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/statistics/): Free statistics calculators for the mean, median, mode, range, standard deviation and variance. Paste your data, get exact answers and see every step shown.
- [Everyday Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/everyday/): Free everyday calculators for exact age, days between dates, business days and GPA. Instant answers as you type, shareable links and nothing to sign up for.
- [Sports and Fitness Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/sports/): Free sports and fitness calculators for running pace, race times and training. Miles or kilometers, splits for every distance and the math shown on every page.
- [Unit Conversion Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/conversion/): Free unit converters for length, weight and temperature: feet to meters, kg to lbs, ounces to grams and Fahrenheit to Celsius, with exact conversion factors.
- [Food and Cooking Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/food/): Free food and cooking calculators: scale any recipe up or down to the servings you need, with every amount resized and rounded to easy kitchen fractions.
- [Physics Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/physics/): Free physics calculators: volts, amps, ohms and watts with Ohm’s law, and what any appliance costs to run in kWh and dollars, with every step shown.
- [Chemistry Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/chemistry/): Free chemistry calculators: molarity, moles, grams to weigh out and volumes to make up, with molar masses of common compounds built in from atomic weights.
- [Biology Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/biology/): Free biology calculators: build Punnett squares for one-, two- or three-gene crosses and see the genotype and phenotype ratios, with each step shown.
- [Ecology and Environment Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/ecology/): Free ecology and environment calculators: work out your car’s yearly CO2 emissions from miles and mpg using EPA emission factors, with the math shown.
- [Other Calculators](https://calcrafty.com/other/): Useful calculators that don’t fit a single category: a tip calculator that splits the bill, and a fuel cost calculator for any road trip or commute.
